title: anisophyllum orbiculatum
intro: Anisophyllum orbiculatum, commonly known as Wild Chamomile or Dwarf Chamomile, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant has been used for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation due to its soothing effects. Its therapeutic actions include anti-anxiety, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and essential oils. The bioactive constituents of Anisophyllum orbiculatum have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and antihistaminic activities.
